data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"The distinction between independent and correlated failures can be identified by the 'Error Signature Entropy'\u2014the variance in failure manifests across the network.","counterconditions":[{"case":"The services are so diverse that the same root cause manifests as entirely different symptoms in every instance.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"The telemetry is too fragmented to collect signatures from a representative sample of failing nodes.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Truly independent failures exhibit high entropy: different services fail with different error codes, stack traces, and temporal offsets.
